title: Defense ministry releases images of jets escorting new F-16Vs
summary: Taipei, Oct. 3 (CNA) The Ministry of National Defense on Saturday released footage and photos of an F-16V Block 20 and Brave Eagle advanced jet trainers escorting two F-16V Block 70s that Taiwan received a day earlier.

title: The activities of the CCP’s 18-machine warship around the Taiwan Strait are closely monitored by the national military and should be dealt with
title_original: 中共18機艦船台海周邊活動 國軍嚴密監控應處
summary: （中央社記者吳書緯台北3日電）國防部表示，自昨天上午6時至今天上午6時，偵獲共機5架次，其中2架次進入西南及東部空域，以及6艘共艦及7艘公務船，總計中共18機艦船持續在台海周邊活動，國軍嚴密監控與應處。

title: Ex-President Tsai Ing-wen to visit U.S., deliver speech at Stanford
summary: Taipei, Oct. 2 (CNA) Former President Tsai Ing-wen (蔡英文) will visit the United States next week to deliver a keynote speech at Stanford University, her office confirmed Friday.

title: DPP, KMT candidates for Kaohsiung mayor ramp up campaigns
summary: Kaohsiung, Oct. 1 (CNA) Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Kaohsiung mayoral candidate Lai Jui-lung (賴瑞隆) on Thursday released his first campaign video, while his Kuomintang (KMT) opponent Ko Chih-en (柯志恩) visited traditional markets in the southern port city.
